scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol color palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and a sophisticated linked sparkline-stats table elevate this above generic, though the 150-line parallel coords is visually dense at render size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Per-axis y-scales are data-driven via d3.extent, sparkline histograms maintain a zero baseline with domain [0, maxCount], key function present in table join, and parallel-coordinate per-dimension normalization is correct; only minor issue is a hardcoded bin threshold of 24 rather than Sturges'/Scott's rule.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF coalescing, pointer-event unification, brush Shift-filter, and absence of transitions all pass; the only weakness is no resize handler, leaving x/y scales and canvas dimensions stale after viewport changes.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Two linked views form one coherent conceptual unit, 6-color palette stays within perceptual limits, and canvas ghosting (10% opacity) manages 150-line density well, but the three-mode interaction model (brush, strum, shift+drag) adds meaningful learning overhead that isn't offset by the hints bar alone.

proposer:
578 lines — that's +10 from the 568 baseline, well within the +20 limit.

Added a compact region color legend between the header and the parallel coordinates chart. This directly addresses the audit's visual_critic note: "the region color legend is absent." The legend uses small color swatches matching the Tol palette already in use, keeping the design cohesive without adding any new encodings or interactions.
